name: ashishpunj
description: Skills by Ashish Punj: the student kit. noguess (the TCE + NHA method), business-blueprint (the plan, in three versions), churn-autopsy (why customers leave, counted before it is fixed), live-shopping (a live selling show on Instagram or Facebook), build-first-crm (a first CRM from a business truth), remotion-ffmpeg-video (a first video). One marketplace, six installs.

plugins.name: noguess
plugins.description: noguess. Make your AI stop guessing. 95% vs 63% in blind tests. The TCE + NHA method as a skill.

plugins.name: business-blueprint
plugins.description: Your business plan in three versions: ten plain questions make v0, a ruthless gap attack makes v1, real answers from real strangers make v2, the Blueprint. Nothing invented.

plugins.name: churn-autopsy
plugins.description: Find why customers leave before deciding how to keep them: a ledger of every customer who left, five suspects scored against it, causes ranked by how many customers each one explains. No cause before the ledger, no fix before the cause.

plugins.name: live-shopping
plugins.description: Plan and run a live shopping show on Instagram or Facebook for a seller in India: eligibility, the running order, a script per product, the order desk from comment to WhatsApp to UPI, and the scorecard. Built from live selling in China and TV selling in the US. Nothing invented, urgency only when true.

plugins.name: build-first-crm
plugins.description: Build a first CRM from BUSINESS-TRUTH.md: landing page, enquiry form, Supabase storage, operator login, and the two emails through Resend. Codex with Sites, or any agent with a static page. Asks before every account, cost or deploy.

plugins.name: remotion-ffmpeg-video
plugins.description: Make and verify a first programmatic video with Remotion and FFmpeg: preflight, a beginner default contract, a verified render, and the noguess check at the end.
